Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking an experienced Python and Django Software Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team in Romania. You will design, build and maintain scalable back-end applications, RESTful APIs and microservices, while contributing to solution and system design, integrations and the gradual migration of monolithic applications towards a microservices architecture.
You will also provide technical consultancy to clients, advise on engineering best practices and support technical decision-making. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, optimisation and knowledge sharing.
 What You’ll Do
Design, develop and maintain high-quality, well-tested back-end services and RESTful APIs using Python and Django 
Write clean, maintainable and efficient code aligned with technical designs and business requirements 
Build and maintain microservices, including integrations with databases, search and logging infrastructure, internal systems and third-party services 
Contribute to the gradual decomposition and re-platforming of monolithic applications in line with established microservices architecture 
Partner with front-end engineers to define and integrate API contracts 
Collaborate with product managers and other stakeholders to support successful and timely delivery 
Contribute across planning, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance 
Perform peer code reviews and participate in debugging and troubleshooting 
Improve back-end performance through caching, query optimisation and efficient data-access techniques 
Apply engineering practices including version control, code review and continuous integration 
Translate business requirements into secure, scalable and performant back-end designs 
Identify technical risks within service designs and recommend appropriate mitigations 
Evaluate relevant tools, frameworks and technologies and contribute to decisions about the team's technology stack 
Produce and maintain technical documentation covering code, APIs, services, operating procedures and architecture 
Support onboarding through knowledge-transfer sessions and technical documentation 
Provide technical support, mentoring and guidance to colleagues across different experience levels 
Contribute to relevant team, department and company initiatives, including technical investigations, analysis, process documentation and knowledge transfer 
 Who You Are
You have 5+ years of back-end development experience, with a strong focus on Python and Django 
You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience 
You have strong proficiency in Python and Django 
You have practical experience designing and building RESTful APIs 
You have experience working with relational databases and SQL 
You understand microservices architecture, distributed systems, design patterns and integration patterns, with practical experience contributing to monolith-to-microservices migration 
You are comfortable using version control systems and build tools 
You understand Agile/Scrum ways of working and can collaborate effectively within a fast-paced engineering environment 
You demonstrate effective problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities 
You can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
You actively develop and share your technical expertise 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/ VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget 
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Loyalty Programme
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
Getting in on the ground floor of a technology changing company
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
Designing scalable Python and Django back-end services 
Building and evolving RESTful APIs and microservices 
Migrating monolithic applications towards microservices architectures 
Performance optimisation, including caching, SQL query optimisation and efficient data access 
Distributed systems and integration patterns 
Technical consultancy and stakeholder communication 
Service architecture, technical risk assessment and documentation 
Technical mentoring, onboarding and knowledge transfer 
CI/CD, observability, containerisation and cloud technologies where these form part of the team's solutions 
 VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
 Join Us
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
